name: Amazon Aurora
description_en:
Amazon Aurora is a product in the Database management category. Its directory profile covers Relational Interface, Queries, Performance Analysis, Monitoring, Database Conversion, Data Search, Data Replication, Data Migration.

Additional listed capabilities include Creation (Development), Backup. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as 24/7 (Live rep), Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: move supported records between systems; create additional copies of selected data. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.

资料还列出创建与开发、数据备份。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务）。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织。API 支持情况为未注明。资料所列支持方式为全天候人工支持, 在线支持。
